drawing.studioModeHelpBodyT2i:
1. Describe the scene in plain text: subject, style, lighting, mood, camera, etc.
2. Open “More options” below for realistic/anime, aspect ratio, negative prompt, seed. If “Custom parameters only” is on, add flags like --ar, --v, --niji, --no in the text yourself—sidebar choices are not appended.
3. No reference images required. Pick model and speed, tap Generate, then watch progress and the 2×2 grid in the job list.
4. After that you can upscale, vary, zoom out, inpaint, and more on a chosen image.
drawing.studioModeHelpBodyI2i:
1. What it is (Midjourney “image prompts”): besides your text, you attach one or more reference images so the model can lean on their layout, subject silhouette, palette, materials, or overall mood. Official docs frame this as guidance and inspiration—not a pixel-perfect copy of the upload.
2. Why use it: when words alone can’t pin down “the general look,” an image anchors structure or style while your text adds scene, lighting, lens, and details. Good for keeping a pose or composition while changing background, genre, or finish.
3. How to write the prompt: still spell out what you want in the final frame (who/what, setting, style, light). The image suggests “like this”; the text says “do this / avoid that.” Images-only with vague text tends to wander.
4. Multiple references: you can upload several; the model blends cues from each. If results feel too tied to the refs—or not tied enough—try Midjourney’s **--iw** (image weight; allowed ranges depend on the model version—see Midjourney “Parameter list / Image weight”).
5. vs. Blend on this page: **Blend** merges 2+ images with little or no text. **Image-to-image** here is “text-led + references”: at least one image plus a full prompt.
6. In HOAI: add reference images in the sidebar and fill the prompt below; style, aspect, negative prompt, and seed behave like text-to-image, and refs are sent together. With “Custom parameters only,” add flags yourself (--ar, --v, --niji, --iw, --no, …). Tap Generate and follow the job list for progress, U/V, upscale, etc.
drawing.studioModeHelpBodySpellDescribe:
1. Describe (image → text): upload an image; the model suggests English prompts suited for Midjourney.
2. You don’t need the main prompt box—just pick an image and tap Generate.
3. When it finishes, a panel opens: image on top, four prompts below. “Put this prompt into image description” copies that line into the Text-to-image sidebar prompt so you can edit and tap Generate yourself—nothing auto-submits.
4. You can also use Copy prompt or the U1–U4 follow-up buttons on the task card when your upstream supports them.
drawing.studioModeHelpBodySpellShorten:
1. Shorten: paste a long prompt in the field below; the model returns a shorter version that keeps the main ideas.
2. Use when your prompt is too long; tap Generate to see the result.
drawing.studioModeHelpBodyBlend:
1. Blend merges 2+ images into a new look—no text prompt.
2. Add images in the sidebar and pick output aspect (portrait 2:3, square 1:1, landscape 3:2).
3. Images are resized/compressed in the browser to keep payloads smaller; cost is often higher than one Imagine—depends on upstream.
4. Tap Generate and check the job list for results.
drawing.studioModeHelpBodyEdits:
1. URL edit changes an existing publicly reachable image from your text (requires upstream /submit/edits).
2. Paste the image URL (or fill from the first job image), describe the edit, and optionally add a PNG mask for regional edits.
3. Unless “Custom parameters only” is on, sidebar style and aspect are still applied; masks help with local changes.
4. Tap Generate and follow the task in the job list.
drawing.mjAdvParamsIntro: Each control defaults to the far left = Off: nothing is appended. Move right (or pick a preset) to add the matching Midjourney flag (see official docs; ranges depend on model version). With Custom parameters off: sidebar ratio/version/seed/negative plus all sliders here (cref/sref/oref, etc.) are merged into the prompt. With it on: write base flags in the description; advanced sliders here are still merged. When you change realistic V6/V7/V8 or Niji version, unsupported reference rows are hidden (e.g. **no --cref on realistic V7/V8**—use **--oref** on V7; Omni --oref and Draft --draft only on realistic V7) and any hidden fields are cleared. **On realistic V7 with a valid Omni URL**, Draft, top quality, and Fast/Turbo are not allowed together—this UI auto-switches to Relax, turns Draft off, and lowers quality per Midjourney’s Omni Reference article.
drawing.mjParamIwHelp:
Balances image prompts vs text. Higher values keep layout, silhouette, and palette closer to your uploads; lower values let the text lead.
This UI maps slider 1–100 to roughly 0.25–2.0 (common V5/V6 bands; verify in Midjourney docs for your version).
It is only appended when at least one reference image is sent with Imagine and the slider is >0.
Shown for Image-to-image, and for Text-to-image once you attach references.
drawing.mjParamStylizeHelp:
Controls how strongly Midjourney’s default “beauty pass” is applied. Higher = more polished gallery look; lower = more literal to your raw wording.
Slider 1–1000 maps to --s; 0 = omit and use model defaults.
Applies to Text-to-image, Image-to-image, and URL edit prompts that follow Imagine syntax.
drawing.mjParamChaosHelp:
Increases variation between the four initial grids. Higher = more exploratory spread; lower = tighter, more similar panels.
Range 0–100 (common cap). 0 = omit.
Use when brainstorming; turn off when you need repeatable comps.
drawing.mjParamWeirdHelp:
Adds unconventional composition and vibe for more experimental outputs.
Range 0–3000 per Midjourney docs. 0 = omit.
Great for art exploration; usually keep off for strict product or corporate looks.
drawing.mjParamStopHelp:
Ends diffusion early for softer, less-detailed previews.
0 or <10 = omit; otherwise 10–100 in steps of 10 maps to --stop.
Use for quick drafts; leave off for full detail.
drawing.mjParamQualityHelp:
Trades compute/time for fidelity (.25 / .5 per docs) or pins 1 / 2.
“Off” sends no --q; other buttons send the matching flag.
If upstream rejects a level, switch back to Off or another tier.
drawing.mjStyleRawHelp:
Turns down Midjourney’s default “beautification” so results follow your wording more literally (official Raw docs use --raw).
When checked, appends --raw at the end of the prompt; behavior varies by model version.
drawing.mjRefUploadHint: After “Upload image”, the backend fills the https URL field below (depends on site configuration). Sign in and pick a Midjourney model above.
drawing.mjRefHttpsFieldHelp: Filled automatically after upload; you can also paste a public https URL Midjourney can fetch. If the field looks empty, use “Copy link” on the right for the same URL.
drawing.mjRefUploadNeedModel: Pick a Midjourney drawing model above before uploading a reference image.
drawing.mjRefUploadNeedLogin: Please sign in before uploading a reference image.
drawing.mjRefUploadFail: Upload failed—try another image or retry later (upstream limits / payload size).
drawing.mjRefUploadNoUrl: Upload finished but no valid image URL was returned. Try again or use another image.
drawing.mjRefUploadTimeout: Reference image upload timed out. Try another image or try again later.
drawing.mjRefUploadStuckHint: If the https link stays empty for a long time, tap Clear and upload again, or try later.
drawing.mjRefCrefSyncWarn: We got a CDN link but the form state didn’t update—paste the same https in the “https URL” field above, or refresh and try again.
drawing.mjRefLocalThumbHint: Local preview before upload; the public https URL is shown in the field above. If it stays empty, hard-refresh the page.
drawing.mjRefNeedUrlHint: Finish upload or enter a valid https URL in the field above; with only a local thumbnail preview, weights are not appended to the prompt.
drawing.mjRefWaitUploadWhenGenerate: A reference image is still uploading to the CDN—wait until you see “Reference link ready”, then tap Generate.
drawing.mjParamCrefCwHelp:
Works with Midjourney Character Reference (--cref); --cw sets how strongly look/outfit cues follow the ref.
Shown only for realistic **V6** and **Niji 6**. **Realistic V7+** upstream rejects `--cref` with `--v 7` (incompatible); on V7 use **Omni Reference (--oref / --ow)** below instead. Realistic **V8** and **Niji 7** hide --cref here—use image prompts (--iw) or --sref.
After upload, the link is written to the https field above.
0 = omit --cw; with a valid https URL, 1–100 is written.
Avoid duplicating --cref in the prompt text.
drawing.mjParamSrefSwSvHelp:
--sref locks broad look, brushwork, or palette; --sw sets style strength; --sv picks a Style Reference sub-version **per Midjourney’s Style Reference article**: realistic / main **V6 → 1–4** (doc default **4**); realistic **V7 → 1–6** (default **6**; legacy style codes often **4**); realistic **V8 → 6 and 7** here (see Version / V8.x notes on GPU combos with `--hd` / `--q 4`); **Niji 7 → 6 only** here until the docs publish a full Niji 7 `--sv` matrix.
The Parameter List ties Style Reference to **V6, V7, and Niji 6**; treat **Niji 7** as “best-effort” vs the latest docs.
Upload fills the https field; you can also paste a URL.
--sw at 0 is omitted; “Off” for --sv omits it.
drawing.mjParamOrefOwHelp:
Omni Reference (--oref) on realistic **V7** steers subject and environment together; --ow sets strength.
This UI shows it **only for realistic V7**; **V8** and **Niji** are often documented without --oref, so the row is hidden—use image prompts or --sref instead.
After upload, the link is written to the https field.
--ow at 0 is omitted.
**Official limits (Omni Reference doc)**: with a valid `--oref`, do not combine **Draft (`--draft`)**, **top quality (`--q 2` in this UI’s “q 2” tier)**, or **Fast Mode**. This page auto-turns Draft off, downgrades top quality to **q 1**, and switches speed to **Relax** (Fast/Turbo disabled) when a valid Omni URL is present.
drawing.mjOrefSpeedRelaxHint: Omni reference is on: Relax is required; Fast and Turbo are disabled per Midjourney docs.
drawing.mjParamTileHelp:
Generates a tileable texture/pattern useful for materials, wallpapers, etc.
When checked, appends --tile to the prompt.
drawing.mjParamDraftHelp:
Official docs describe Draft mode for realistic V7: faster jobs and lower GPU use, with less detail.
Shown only for realistic V7; when checked, appends --draft. Realistic V8.x upstream often rejects Draft jobs, so the toggle is hidden there.
drawing.mjParamV8OutputHelp:
Matches Midjourney V8.1 docs:
• Default: append nothing (upstream default resolution path).
• SD (--sd): standard-definition path per docs.
• HD (--hd): higher-res (e.g. 2K) path; usually more GPU time. Combining with --q 4 or some --sv cases may be restricted or surcharged—see official Version / Quality docs.
Mutually exclusive; shown only for realistic + V8.
drawing.mjParamRepeatHint: 0 or 1 = off. 2–40 runs multiple initial grids in one submission (each grid is usually 4 images). Max allowed depends on your plan; Relax may not support it—see Midjourney Repeat docs.
drawing.mjSpellApiHelpBodyDescribe:
Describe (image → text): upload one image; the proxy returns English prompt fragments you can paste into Text-to-image or Image-to-image.
This mode does not use Imagine flags like --ar, --s, or --iw. You can leave the main prompt box empty and tap Generate after choosing an image.
drawing.mjSpellApiHelpBodyShorten:
Shorten compresses a long prompt while keeping the main ideas.
Only text is sent to the shorten endpoint—no reference images or Imagine sliders.
drawing.mjBlendApiHelpBody:
Blend endpoints typically accept multiple images plus an aspect preset (portrait 2:3, square 1:1, landscape 3:2) without a text prompt, so Imagine-only flags such as --iw, --s, or --chaos are not part of this request.
Cost and latency are often higher than a single Imagine—follow your upstream billing.
drawing.mjBlendBottomHint: Pick 2+ images and blend aspect in the sidebar—no text prompt. Upstream billing is often ~4× one Imagine.
drawing.mjEditsHint: Requires upstream /submit/edits: a public image URL (e.g. CDN) and optional PNG mask. Sidebar prompt still gets --v / --ar etc. unless “custom params only” is on.
drawing.mjEditsPromptPlaceholder: Describe how to change the image…
drawing.mjEditsFillFirstUrl: Fill first image URL from jobs (records source for parent link)
drawing.mjEditsFillFromCardTitle: Fill the Edits image URL, switch to the Edits tab, and link this card as the parent on submit
drawing.mjEditsFillFromCardImgTitle: Fill Edits with this image (click the main image area to preview larger)
drawing.mjEditsFilledFromCard: Filled the Edits tab; edit your prompt and submit
drawing.mjEditsMaskReady: Mask selected; it will be sent with the request
drawing.mjEditsNoImageToFill: No image URL available in the job list
drawing.mjSimpleChangePlaceholder: Content as required by upstream (e.g. taskId + action code)
drawing.mjSidebarMoreOptions: More: style, aspect ratio, negative prompt…
drawing.studioAspectCustomInvalid: Use “W:H” with integers from 1 to 9999 on each side
drawing.mjCustomParamsHintShort: Off by default. When on, ratio/version/seed/negative are not auto-appended—write --ar, --v, etc. in the description. Advanced sidebar flags (cref/sref, --s, --iw, …) are still merged.
drawing.mjCustomParamsSwitchAria: Toggle: manual base Midjourney flags only (default off)
drawing.mjCustomParamsHint: When enabled, base flags (--ar, --v/--niji, --seed, --no) are not auto-appended; write them in the description. The “Advanced parameters” sidebar (cref/sref/oref, --s, --iw, etc.) is still merged into the submitted prompt (avoid duplicating the same flags in text).
drawing.mjCustomParamsActiveBanner: Custom parameters on: write --ar, --v, --seed, --niji, --no, etc. in the image description. Sidebar ratio, version, seed, and negative prompt are not auto-appended; advanced sliders (cref/sref, --s, blend --iw, …) are still appended.
drawing.mjVersionHint: Realistic: --v (V6–V8). Anime: --niji (Niji 6 or 7), separate from --v. See Midjourney docs.
drawing.mjSeedHint: Random noise seed for reproducibility (0–4294967295). Leave empty for random. Seed locking can be unreliable in Turbo mode (official note).
drawing.mjSeedPlaceholder: Optional (e.g. seed copied from a result)
drawing.negativePlaceholder: Things to exclude, e.g. blurry, extra fingers…
drawing.studioTips: Describe the scene; avoid imperative commands for better results.
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroRefineUpscale: Upscale again after the first upscale: Subtle stays closest to the original; Creative lets the model add detail (Midjourney Upscalers).
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroVaryEdit: Create variations from the current image, or repaint only a selected region; with Remix you can edit the prompt (Vary / Vary Region).
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroZoomOut: Shrink the subject and extend the canvas outward—like stepping back; includes 1.5×, 2×, or custom zoom and prompt (Zoom Out).
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroPan: Expand the canvas in one direction; new areas are filled to match your image and prompt (Pan).
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroAnimate: Turn a still into a short motion clip; behaviour depends on upstream integration.
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroUtility: One-tap tools such as background removal—availability depends on your upstream.
drawing.mjMiscGroupIntroOther: Actions we could not classify or custom labels from the proxy; hover the button for the full upstream label.
drawing.mjMiscPolicyAnimateBody: Short motion clips (e.g. Animate High / Low motion) are temporarily unavailable here due to high cost.
drawing.mjMiscPolicyUtilityBody: Utility tools (e.g. Remove Background) are temporarily unavailable.
drawing.mjHintUpscaleSubtle: Subtle upscaler: minimal change—mostly sharper detail while preserving the look.
drawing.mjHintUpscaleCreative: Creative upscaler: may change the image while fixing small issues (e.g. hands); more freedom than Subtle.
drawing.mjHintVarySubtleFollowup: Variation very close to this image (small differences).
drawing.mjHintVaryStrongFollowup: Stronger variation—composition and content may differ more.
drawing.mjHintVaryRegion: Repaint only the masked region; the rest stays fixed. Larger masks give the model more context.
drawing.mjHintZoomOut2x: Preset ~2× zoom-out: about twice as wide a field of view.
drawing.mjHintZoomOut15x: Preset ~1.5× zoom-out: between moderate and strong extension.
drawing.mjHintCustomZoom: Set zoom factor and optionally change the prompt for the expanded framing.
drawing.mjHintZoomOutGeneric: Zoom out and generate new content around the image (Zoom Out).
drawing.mjHintPanLeft: Extend the canvas to the left; keep the right side, generate new content on the left.
drawing.mjHintPanRight: Extend to the right; keep the left, generate on the right.
drawing.mjHintPanUp: Extend upward; keep the bottom, generate above.
drawing.mjHintPanDown: Extend downward; keep the top, generate below.
drawing.mjHintAnimateHigh: Higher-motion animation (depends on upstream clip tool).
drawing.mjHintAnimateGeneric: Generate a short motion clip from the still (upstream-dependent).
drawing.mjHintRemoveBg: Try to isolate the subject from the background; edges vary by image complexity.
drawing.mjHintReroll: Run the same prompt again for a new stochastic sample.
drawing.mjVaryRegionHintDrag: Drag to select the region to repaint (white mask = edited area).
drawing.mjVaryRegionHintPolyHtml: Left-click to add vertices; the dashed line previews the next edge. With at least 3 points, move near the green first point (glow ring) and click to close, or use Close selection / Enter. Backspace, Undo last point, or right-click removes the last vertex.
drawing.mjVaryRegionPromptPlaceholder: (Optional) Describe changes in the selection; leave empty to keep the original task prompt
drawing.mjVaryRegionPolygonNeedThree: A polygon needs at least three vertices.
drawing.mjVaryRegionNoImage: No image available for this task.
drawing.mjVaryRegionEnterFail: Could not open inpainting: {msg}. Please try again later.
drawing.mjVaryRegionDirectQueued: No mask step; queued as a normal follow-up task.
drawing.mjCustomZoomHint: Use the zoom slider for pull-back strength; we append --zoom on submit. Edit the prompt below for text or --ar as needed.
drawing.mjCustomZoomSliderFootnote: About 1×–2×: higher reveals more canvas (subject appears smaller), aligned with Midjourney Custom Zoom.
drawing.mjCustomZoomPromptPlaceholder: Optional: edit prompt or --ar; zoom level is controlled by the slider (any --zoom in text is replaced on submit)
drawing.mjCustomZoomEnterFail: Could not open custom zoom: {msg}. Please try again later.
drawing.mjFailModalWindow: Drawing could not finish: the service did not confirm this step. Please try again later. For inpainting or similar flows, try a different selection or prompt.
drawing.mjFailModalInvalid: Drawing was not accepted. Try a simpler or English prompt, or use a rectangular selection and try again.
drawing.mjErrQueueFull: The queue is full. Please try again later.
drawing.mjErrNotEnoughRatings: Upstream says requirements aren’t met yet (often not enough ratings/engagement; it can also relate to the Midjourney account this site assigns/rotates for you not meeting Midjourney’s eligibility for Global Personalization—that usually includes rating thresholds and other account conditions). Start a new job and try a few times—we’ll automatically try other available accounts.
drawing.mjErrV8GlobalPersonalization: Realistic V8 depends on Midjourney Global Personalization eligibility: you typically need sufficient ratings and other account-side conditions. The upstream account we route for you may not meet those requirements yet. Start a new job and try a few times—we’ll automatically try other available accounts.

drawing.mjParentNavigateTitle: Scroll to and highlight the task this follow-up was based on
drawing.mjParentNotFound: Could not find the source task. It may have been removed or is not in this list.
drawing.mjDeleteFail: Could not delete. Please try again.
drawing.mjPromptTipsGood: Good: sunset lighthouse by the sea, warm tones, film grain
drawing.mjPromptTipsBad: Avoid: draw me a picture (imperative prompts work poorly)
drawing.i2iNeedImage: Upload at least one reference image for image-to-image
drawing.mjNoTaskId: Upstream did not return a task id (expected result / taskId).
drawing.mjInterruptedRefresh: Submit was interrupted by refresh. Please try again.
drawing.mjRestoreNoModel: Original drawing model is missing; cannot resume this task.
drawing.mjTasksLocalPersist: When signed in, jobs sync to your account and appear on any device. When logged out, they stay in this browser only.
drawing.mjImageLoadFailed: Image failed to load. Try refresh.
drawing.mjImageStallHint: Still slow — the app will fetch the image via your server for inline display. You can still open the original URL in a new tab.
drawing.viewerCaptionDetailHint: Full prompt and translation for easy copy or review.
drawing.viewerOpenInNewTabTitle: Open the image in a new tab, then right-click → Save image as… (pages cannot open the system context menu for you)
drawing.viewerShortcutHint: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · ESC to close
drawing.viewerSaveBlockedWithLink: Can't save directly (often cross-origin). Image URL copied — paste into a download manager or browser.
drawing.viewerSaveBlockedManual: Can't read image data. Right-click the preview image and use Save image as…
